description: Perform a portfolio reconciliation. You are provided with a broker statement CSV file at '~/Documents/jan_2024_statement.csv' which lists all valid stock purchases for January 2024. Compare this statement against the transactions currently recorded in JStock's 'My Portfolio'. Identify the one transaction that appears in the statement but is missing from JStock. Manually record this missing 'Buy' transaction in JStock with the exact Date, Stock Symbol, Units, and Purchase Price listed in the statement. Ensure the existing transactions remain unchanged.
